gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-nag-mundari: Commanding up top, then relaxed below. Noto Sans Nag Mundari keeps its lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals, so a long passage feels dense yet easy to move through, with curves that look half unwrapped.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-nandinagari: Goldman spreads its round, parenthesis-like letters wide and sets a tall lowercase against small capitals, which is its whole trick. Noto Sans Nandinagari does the quiet work, with generous openings and short ascenders.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Goldman does its best work as a wide, round-formed heading with plenty of clearance between letters. And Noto Sans Nushu handles the reading, with a towering x-height and terminals held far from the stroke.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Noto Sans Ogham makes its tall lowercase look almost bold, with wide gaps in the e. Goldman is the one built to command attention, while the body simply carries the text.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-ol-chiki: Noto Sans Ol Chiki holds its curve tails well back from the body. Over a long stretch, words settle into solid blocks instead of jagged skylines, which makes the text feel tidy, steady and unhurried under Goldman.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-old-hungaria: Goldman brings wide-set, bold letters with round forms that look like open parentheses, then hands over to Noto Sans Old Hungarian. Its open counters keep a long passage clear and friendly, even at tiny sizes.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-old-italic: Tightly packed and businesslike, with almost no gap between lowercase and capitals. Noto Sans Old Italic keeps curve endings well apart, so a long passage reads crisply beneath the wide, bold Goldman.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-old-north-ar: Noto Sans Old North Arabian forms a dense, tall band of lowercase, its terminals flaring outward like a pair of tongs. Goldman sits above it as the wide, bold voice, while the sans does the steady talking.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-old-permic: Goldman is the show-off here, wide and commanding with round, generous letterforms. But Noto Sans Old Permic does the plain-sans job, with rounded shapes open to the side and a lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-old-persian: Tall, wide and confident, with a lofty lowercase underneath a commanding display heading. Goldman supplies the swagger, while Noto Sans Old Persian lets its open counters breathe into the white space.
